notes: Platform use: 11 of 12 Meetup pages used (meditation, drawing, improv, choir, knitting, dance, jam sessions, parents, volunteering, sketching, music). Several topic pages (drawing, sketching, choir, dance, jam sessions, parents) returned only a skip link with no listings, so their groups were not seen and no bot check or 403 was recorded. No login was attempted. Join Philly was not used. Searches: all 8 used, so many Meetup groups could not be followed to their own sites; the budget ran out before more could be checked. Brahma Kumaris: one search found no Philadelphia center (nearest listed is Pittsburgh), so it was not recorded. Out of area Meetup groups seen but not recorded: several South Jersey knitting and craft groups, Montgomery County, several New York and New Jersey meditation and music groups, and Suburban Philly Adventures. Status calls: four records are active or probably active on dated or working-site evidence; Code for Philly is unknown; the Philadelphia Drunken Knitwits record rests on a March 2025 news story only.

records.name: Philadelphia Drunken Knitwits
records.summary: A group of knitters and crocheters who meet weekly on Wednesday evenings in bars and restaurants around central Philadelphia. The Philadelphia chapter has met since 2017.
records.what_you_do: Bring a project, knit or crochet at the table, and talk with the group.

schedule.text: Weekly on Wednesday evenings at a rotating bar or restaurant in Center City or University City; 21 and over

locations.label: Rotating bars and restaurants, Center City or University City

records.notes: The 2025 news story and a fiber group list both describe weekly Wednesday meetings. Neither confirms the group still meets. The group's only contact found is a Meetup page, which was used as a lead only, so no contact is recorded. The venue rotates, so the group list may be out of date. The joining process is not published on a non-platform page, so no first step is recorded.
_held_reasons: status is required for tier 1 and tier 2 records
